hints: Focus on the type of reaction here, a carboxylic acid with H+ catalyst reacting to make that O-C=O linkage screams esterification.
Spot which end of the product came from ethanoic acid, the $\text{CH}_3\text{COO}$ part on the right, so the rest must have come from X.
Remember esterification is alcohol + acid to ester + water, so to get back to X just replace the ester O-acyl group with an OH group and count atoms.
walkthrough:
**Recognise the reaction type**

Think like a detective. Carboxylic acid + another compound with H+ catalyst to give a product containing $\text{-O-C=O}$ is esterification.

General rule:
$$\text{R-OH + CH}_3\text{COOH} \rightarrow \text{R-OCOCH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Split the product into its two parents**

Look at the product: $\text{CH}_3\text{CO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-O-CO-CH}_3$.

The right hand $\text{-O-C(=O)-CH}_3$ fragment is from ethanoic acid. The left hand $\text{CH}_3\text{CO-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-O-}$ fragment must be from compound X.

**Rebuild compound X**

In esterification the OH of the alcohol is kept as the O in the ester, and H2O is lost. So reverse it by swapping $\text{-O-COCH}_3$ back to $\text{-OH}$.

That gives X as $\text{CH}_3\text{-C(=O)-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-OH}$, which is 4-hydroxybutan-2-one.

**Count atoms for the molecular formula**

Count carefully from $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$:

Carbons: 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4. Hydrogens: 3 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 8. Oxygens: 1 (ketone) + 1 (alcohol) = 2.

So molecular formula is $$\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}_2$$

options.A: C2H4O is too small and has only one O. It ignores the left-hand ketone part of the product. X must supply the whole CH3COCH2CH2 skeleton, which alone is already C4.
options.B: C2H6O2 looks like a diol or hydroxy acid fragment. It comes from only counting the right-hand side or guessing a 2-carbon alcohol, but the product clearly shows a 4-carbon chain on the alcohol side plus a ketone.
options.C: C4H8O has the right carbon and hydrogen count but is missing one oxygen. This is the trap of forgetting X is a hydroxy-ketone with two O atoms, one in C=O and one in OH, not just a ketone.
options.D: C4H8O2 is correct for CH3COCH2CH2OH. When this hydroxy-ketone reacts with ethanoic acid, the OH esterifies to give CH3COCH2CH2OCOCH3 plus water, exactly matching the structure shown.
